task.check's outputs list the alias_family block only 'if OPEN-SKEL-3 is decided for its option B'. N14b-17 exposes Task::alias_family() under every option, including the default (source grid), and task.check reports `alias_family: {source, size, digest}` or `{not_finite: [...]}` from M3; BD-244 logs it for the stage-8 cases and N14b-17's e2e asserts it on a gridded task. State the output unconditionally from M3 (source grid or block), else the generated output schema has no field for the default case.
